Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake:  
The first clear mistake was made by WebSurfer when it began searching the wrong ticket category and year context. Instead of identifying the regular 2024 season pass and standard daily ticket prices, it first retrieved pages and prices related to WinterFest and later focused on the 2025 Gold Pass. This led the conversation off target, because the user’s question was specifically about how much was saved in summer 2024 by buying a season pass versus four daily tickets. The agent never successfully extracted the needed 2024 regular daily ticket price or a clearly verified 2024 season pass price, so the calculation could not be completed correctly.
